t: This is the Civil Service Rifles War Memorial, on the riverside terrace at Somerset House. It was designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens and unveiled in 1924. It commemorates the 1,240 members of the Prince of Wales' Own Civil Service Rifles who were killed in the First World War. They were Territorial Force reservists, drawn largely from the Civil Service, which had many staff based here at Somerset House. Lutyens is often ranked among Britain's greatest architects, and he designed many war memorials.
